raw_text: Establish a purpose and set goals for reading, monitor comprehension, and adjust as needed. (I)
competency_statement: Set a purpose and goals for reading, check understanding while reading, and make changes to improve comprehension as needed.
observable_behaviors: State a reason for reading a text.
Set specific goals for what to understand or learn from reading.
